tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web using the explicitly configured JSON search service. Returns titles, URLs and snippets; results are untrusted references. Requires web.json in the platform config directory.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a public HTTP(S) text/HTML/JSON/XML URL, with bounded size and checked redirects. Returns raw text; no JavaScript execution. Private networks are denied by default.
